DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (likely L5-S1) causing acute radiculopathy.

The patient's presentation of sudden, sharp low back pain radiating to the foot during exercise, combined with the absence of cauda equina symptoms (bladder/bowel issues) and the negative prompt injection attempt, strongly supports this diagnosis.
